title: Holiday and Sunday hours (the image)
opening: Are you guys open this Sunday? And what about Thanksgiving?
callerBrief: You are Wei Cruz, phone 512-865-1554, at 7992 Sunset Terrace, Pflugerville. Ask if phone support is open this Sunday, then what the hours are on Thanksgiving, then what the fee is if you have an emergency on a holiday. Give your name and phone only if asked. Then say that is all. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: Phone support is closed on Sunday; it is open Monday to Friday 7am to 7pm and Saturday 8am to 4pm
On Thanksgiving, November 26 and 27, the office is closed and the emergency line is open
The holiday emergency dispatch fee is $199

dbChange.detail: No database change. Sunday hours come from the 2026 FAQ; Thanksgiving and the holiday fee come from the holiday-hours image.
